Bill.BriefDescription: Creating programs to promote prevention of child abuse and neglect.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the funding of prevention and early interventionservices; and adding new sections to chapter 74.13 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that investment in effective prevention andearly intervention services: (1) Produces immediate and longtermimprovements for children and families; and (2) avoids future publiccosts in education, child welfare, substance abuse, health, and mentalhealth treatment, law enforcement and the courts, and juvenile andadult corrections. The legislature further finds that state agenciesreceiving funds for prevention and early intervention services shouldcontract for or operate services that have a strong likelihood ofachieving expected outcomes.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The children's administration in the department of social andhealth services shall identify and implement criteria for funding p. 1 SHB 1841prevention and early intervention services and programs that are eitherstateoperated or contracted. The criteria must require that fundedprograms, at a minimum: (a) Define clear, measurable outcomes; (b)identify research that may be applicable; (c) identify anticipatedcosteffectiveness; (d) describe broad community involvement, support,and partnerships; and (e) provide data related to program outcomes. (2) The children's administration shall collect and analyze theprogram data and make the data and the analysis available for publicreview. (3) For the purposes of this section, "prevention and earlyintervention services and programs" shall include, but not be limitedto, the following or their successors: (a) Alternate response system; (b) Family reconciliation services; (c) Family preservation services; (d) Intensive family preservation services; (e) Continuum of care; (f) Community public health and safety networks; (g) Parent trust programs; (h) Homebased services; and (i) Public health nurse early intervention program. (4) The children's administration shall incorporate the fundingcriteria into contracts and operating policies within existingresources.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature recognizes the importance of evaluation andoutcome measurements of prevention and early intervention programs inorder to ensure the costeffective use of public funds. (2) The Washington state institute for public policy shall conducta review of existing research to identify specific researchprovenprevention and early intervention programs that pertain to familiesinvolved with or at risk of becoming involved with child protectiveservices. The review shall focus on programs that produce a positivereturn on the dollar compared to the cost of the program. (3) The Washington state institute for public policy shall report SHB 1841 p. 2 its findings to the appropriate committees of the legislature no laterthan January 1, 2004.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this act shall be construed to create: (1) An entitlement to services; (2) Judicial authority to order the provision of services to anyperson or family if the services are unavailable or unsuitable, or thechild or family is not eligible for such services; or (3) A private right of action or claim on the part of anyindividual, entity, or agency.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature encourages other administrations within thedepartment of social and health services and other state agenciesfunding prevention and early intervention services to identify andimplement the funding criteria provided in section 2 of this act.
